Specification: This module, ACP_SB_TLC, adapts the ACP_SB specification for use with the TLC model checker. It extends the ACP_SB and TLC modules, indicating that it builds on an existing atomic commit protocol specification and adds TLC-specific constructs. The module introduces a symmetry set for participants using permutations to optimize model checking. It also provides an alternative formulation of the AC4 property (AC4_alt) that is more suitable for TLC's handling, ensuring that once a participant's decision is commit or abort, it remains so in the next state. Additionally, it defines a liveness property (AllDecide) stating that eventually every participant will make a decision (either commit or abort). The design focuses on making the specification more amenable to automated checking and symmetry reduction.
